TS-USB4.description: M.2 mode: PCIe x4 through the M.2 Key M socket J8 (USB4 adapter) to the FPGA

source.note: commit df2b845: the BOM has no part of the sheet /TS-PCIe Components/ except C22, C83, C84; the PCIe edge fingers P1 stay as copper

notes: Assembly variants TS-PCIe and TS-USB4 (separate BOMs and position files, parts on the sheets /TS-PCIe Components/ and /TS-USB4 Components/); TS-PCIe is analysed. The power tree is that of TS-PCIe (12 V from the slot), all four channels active; the M.2/USB4 supply path (J8, R54) is not computed. Currents from datasheets (typ.) or estimated; efficiencies estimated from typical curves.

Laminate: Isola FR408HR throughout (Fab_Readme.txt), Df at 2 GHz from the data sheet; impedance targets of the QSPI flash nets assumed (50 Ω); the analog classes keep kisi's generic profiles on purpose.
Not filled in (optional): thermal data (PI_THERMAL) of 14 parts – package defaults apply (estimates), the data sheets' Thermal Information tables were not entered.
Power tree first converted from a kisi power tree with tools/tree_to_fields.py.
